Description
The 5 gram Credit Suisse Gold Bar Statue of Liberty (New Assay)” is a gold bullion bar manufactured by Credit Suisse, a Swiss bank. The bar weighs 5 grams and features an image of the Statue of Liberty on the front. The “New Assay” designation likely indicates that the bar has been recently assayed or tested for purity and weight by Credit Suisse. The bar is made of pure gold with a fineness of 999.9.
The 5 gram Credit Suisse Gold Bar Statue of Liberty (New Assay) is a small, portable, high-quality gold bullion bar recently assayed by Credit Suisse, a reputable Swiss bank. Its image of the statue of Liberty makes it a unique and attractive option for investors.
Main Highlights of 5 gram Credit Suisse Gold Bar
The 5 grams Credit suisse gold bars contain 5 grams(.1607 oz) of .9999 pure gold.
The 5 grams lady liberty gold bars come in a TEP package meaning additional security.
This lady liberty bar is eligible for precious metal IRAs
